messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5m error rate on /v1/embeddings (service=inference-embeds). Started at 5523456700. Current errors 18%. Auto-thread created.

maya: seeing big tail latencies on embeds. p50 ~1.6s, p95 ~3.8s. pool-embeds CPUs pegged.

sam: paging @liam (oncall). please jump in. any obvious hotcustomers?

liam: oncall ack. pulling request traces and top clients now.

maya: two tenants account for ~72% of embed tokens in last 10m: corp-gamma and research-alpha, both sending very large batched requests.

liam: looks like KV cache churn + huge batched sequences causing native kernels to spike. chat endpoint mostly fine.

jess: runbook step: start with per-route QPS cap + reduce embed request max_tokens. escalate to disabling heavy-precision path if needed.

liam: propose temporary global caps to buy breathing room: embeds qps=45 burst=90; rerank qps=6 burst=12. also set per-request token cap to 1500 for embeds.

maya: go for it. I'll draft AM note to affected customers and SOC/AM team.

liam:
```
# live admin
rbctl route update --route-id embeds --qps 45 --burst 90 --reason "emergency capacity relief: embed surge"
rbctl route update --route-id rerank --qps 6 --burst 12 --reason "temporary rerank trim to free capacity"
rbctl route update --route-id embeds --max_tokens 1500 --reason "limit per-request cost during surge"
```

ops-bot: RBCTL: executed by liam @ 5523456905. Changes applied.

sam: monitoring: errors dropping to 6% in 3m window, CPU on pool-embeds down from 91% -> 68%.

liam: enabling per-customer soft caps to prevent a single tenant consuming >30% of route QPS. Will be soft reject (429) with guidance.

liam:
```
rbctl tenant-qos set --tenant corp-gamma --route embeds --soft_qps 15 --reason "prevent single-tenant blast"
rbctl tenant-qos set --tenant research-alpha --route embeds --soft_qps 12 --reason "prevent single-tenant blast"
```

jess: opening tickets + AM pings. note: both tenants on enterprise; coordinate mitigation note and ask them to switch to smaller batch sizes or use streaming embed API.

maya: customer-impact estimates: corp-gamma saw ~22% 429s during peak window; research-alpha ~18%. Other customers saw small latency increases but few 5xxs.

sre-lead: handoff: @liam keep caps in place for 45 minutes and confirm error rate <2% for two consecutive 5m windows before relaxing rerank. If CPU stays >70%, escalate to infra for kernel-level tuning.

liam: ACK. posting checkpoints every 10m.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: created INC-55234567. Priority set P1 -> will drop to P2 if stable within 30m.

sam: follow-ups: - add auto-trigger rule: if embeddings qps > baseline x6 then auto-apply route qps cap - add runbook note about per-tenant soft_qps - evaluate adding an embed-streaming guide for high-throughput customers

jess: adding action: postmortem owner=maya + jess, due 3 business days. include mitigation commands and AM communications.

liam: status @ 5523457500: errors 1.4%, CPU 59%. keeping tenant soft caps and embed max_tokens. planning to restore rerank qps to 20 in 20m if stable.

maya: great. switching to monitoring-only. will update incident doc with timestamps and command snippets.

sre-lead: nice work. ensure AMs confirm outreach and include a recommended throttling/streaming plan for the two customers in the postmortem.
